hypothesised_pattern: The target is a saturating even function of x4 that is low (0.05-0.26) for |x4| <= 0.35 and plateaus at about 0.6-0.75 for |x4| >= 0.77, with an additive positive x1 effect and a negative x3 effect.
rationale: Seven rows with |x4| of 0.77-1.93 have targets 0.58-0.94, and three rows with |x4| <= 0.35 have 0.05-0.26, so the target depends on |x4| and saturates quickly. The highest plateau target (0.94) has the largest x1 (+2.09) and negative x3, the lowest plateau target (0.58) has the largest x3 (+1.09), and the lowest overall (0.05) has x1 = -1.88.
